title: Reflow plain text to a display width
why_not_offtheshelf: textwrap exists, but it counts characters rather than columns, has no notion of a wide character being its own breakable piece, hangs nothing under a bullet marker, knows nothing about fenced blocks, and collapses blank runs. This contract requires all five, so a wrapper recalled from textwrap's behaviour fails the hidden checks.
visible_note: prereg S1-2 freezes '3 visible checks'; realised as 3 visible test files, one per frozen check.
contract_additions: goal: added the two-columns sentence, the break-between-characters sentence, the blank-run sentence, the each-bullet sentence, the long-run sentence and the bad-width sentence -- anchors for the prereg's hidden list, per prereg S5-2 gate 1.
contract: pinned greedy filling, that no output line ends in a space, the whitespace-collapse rule, and the final-newline rule.
ref_solution_lines_rule: prereg S1-3b: every .py of the reference solution, each normalised with ast.unparse(ast.parse(src)), non-blank lines counted and summed. bad_*.py are known-bad stakes, not the reference solution, and are excluded.
boundary_only_hidden_n_note: prereg S1-3b: marked by the S5-2 reviewer, who must not be the task author. Left null on purpose: the author filling it in would destroy the measure.
